sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By using Town Crier, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the app. We may update these terms from time to time and will notify you of material changes.

sections.heading: Service Description
sections.body: Town Crier provides notifications about UK local authority planning applications based on your chosen locations. Planning data is sourced from PlanIt (planit.org.uk) and local authority public registers. While we strive for accuracy, we do not guarantee the completeness or timeliness of planning data.

sections.heading: Subscriptions
sections.body: Town Crier has a free tier and paid plans, all bought through the Apple App Store. Apple takes the payment. Personal and Pro are subscriptions, paid monthly, or yearly for Pro annual. They renew automatically at the end of each period, and Apple charges you the price shown in the App Store, until you cancel. Personal monthly comes with a 7-day free trial if you haven't had one before. If you don't cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, it becomes a paid subscription and Apple charges you. You can cancel at any time in your App Store account settings. Cancel at least 24 hours before your renewal date to avoid the next charge. You keep your plan until the end of the period you've paid for. Refunds are handled by Apple in accordance with their refund policy. Pro is also available as a one-off lifetime purchase. It is not a subscription and does not renew. It gives you Pro for as long as Town Crier runs. If we ever close Town Crier, lifetime access ends with it. Buying lifetime Pro does not cancel a subscription you already have, so cancel that in your App Store account settings.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use
sections.body: You agree to use Town Crier for its intended purpose of monitoring planning applications. You must not attempt to reverse-engineer the app, scrape data at scale, or use the service to harass or spam other users or planning authorities.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Planning data comes from councils and PlanIt, and it can be late, incomplete, or wrong. Always check anything important with your local authority before you act on it. We are not liable for decisions made based on planning data shown in the app. Apart from that, our total liability to you is limited to the amount you have paid us in the 12 months before your claim. Nothing in these terms limits or excludes our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, or for anything else the law does not let us limit. Nothing in these terms affects your legal rights as a consumer, including your rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015 that the app is of satisfactory quality, fit for purpose, and as described.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales. If you live in Scotland or Northern Ireland, you can bring a claim in the courts where you live, and you keep the protections the law there gives you. Otherwise, disputes go to the courts of England and Wales.
